verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch can be started locally with a curl one-liner and driven through official language clients, and the docs describe creating an index mapping and then ingesting, embedding, and querying data with no pipeline setup. An official MCP server and agent skills for AI coding agents round out a dashboard-free agent workflow. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the REST endpoints for creating indexes and bulk-indexing documents, documentation of which operations the MCP server exposes (writes vs. reads), a headless path for creating a Cloud project instead of trial signup, machine-readable OpenAPI/llms.txt (probes returned 404), and hands-on corroboration of an agent doing this end to end.
